Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1130
Claimant:
Kathleen Garcia
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
6 Apr 2024
Claim received for a rear-end collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck from behind while stopped at a traffic
signal. Claimant reports a wrist fracture and is represented by counsel, so all contact will go through the attorney's
office.
16 Apr 2024
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is named on it and that coverage was in force at the time of loss.
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
12 May 2024
Photos of the rear bumper and trunk area were obtained from the insured and the claimant's side. They confirm
several details of the impact, but no independent witnesses have come forward.
3 Jun 2024
Vehicle damage appears mostly consistent with the impact described by both parties. No prior damage to the vehicle
is known from our records or from the repair shop's preliminary notes.
12 Jun 2024
Claimant's account of the collision was given in a recorded statement and again in a follow-up call through counsel.
The same sequence of events was described each time.
23 Jun 2024
Medical records received show the wrist fracture and a course of treatment that followed a typical pattern, tapering off
as the claimant improved. It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
24 Jun 2024
Prior records show a small strain in the same area several years ago, which resolved fully. Requested further imaging
history to determine whether it bears on the current findings.
30 Jun 2024
Still unclear from the statements and photos exactly where the claimant was seated in the vehicle at impact. Asked
counsel to clarify the seating position in writing.
31 Jul 2024
Sent a letter to counsel requesting the outstanding medical bills, the proir treatment records, and the claimant's
employment information for the wage loss portion of the claim.
22 Sep 2024
Claim remains open pending receipt of the requested records and the mediacl review. Next step is to schedule an
independent medical review once the prior treatment file arrives.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
